findings.claim: The default Compose stack exposes an insecure direct Electric endpoint that bypasses the verified tenant/projection boundary.
findings.evidence: The added `electric` service sets `ELECTRIC_INSECURE: "true"` and publishes `"${ELECTRIC_PORT:-3000}:3000"`; the file's own comment states that with this port published, callers can request "a base-table shape with no projection and no where-clause." This conflicts with the acceptance requirement to "Preserve verified tenant scope" and criterion 1.3 requiring approved document metadata projection with source text and embeddings structurally absent.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not publish Electric directly in the default stack; keep it on an internal network and require access through the authorized Gate/FRF shape facade, or move the direct port exposure behind an explicit unsafe development-only profile that is not the default.
